zh.title: 护肤产品视觉｜让人物表达服务产品识别
zh.summary: 围绕护肤产品组织人物形象与视觉内容，在人物吸引力与产品可识别性之间建立清晰关系，为产品主题传播提供具体画面。
zh.preview: 人物吸引注意，产品信息说明内容主题。本案将妆造准备与产品制作纳入同一任务，使两者共同服务护肤内容。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与护肤产品内容制作与妆造形象设计，围绕产品呈现完成人物准备及相关影像。
zh.context: 本案是一项人物参与的护肤产品内容项目。画面同时包含人物、产品与标识，需要让人物表达保持吸引力，也让产品主题能够被直接辨认。

narrativeSections.heading: 人物与产品各有信息任务
narrativeSections.text: 人物为观看者提供情绪与形象入口，产品和标识则交代内容所指。二者在同一画面中出现，使护肤主题拥有可识别的视觉对象。

narrativeSections.heading: 形象设计服从内容主题
narrativeSections.text: 妆造设计是本案制作范围的一部分，人物准备因此需要回应护肤产品的呈现。内容制作将人物与产品共同组织在画面中，而非分别作为互不相关的交付。

narrativeSections.heading: 产品沟通的视觉基础
narrativeSections.text: 这类影像可用于产品主题介绍与内容编辑，为传播提供人物和产品同框的材料。清楚的人物与产品关系，让后续编辑可以从整体形象或产品主题两个角度使用这份材料。

deliverables: 围绕护肤产品内容的人物妆造设计
包含人物、产品及标识的视觉内容
outcomes: 形成兼具人物呈现与产品识别信息的护肤内容。
交付可作为产品主题编辑与视觉沟通的素材。

en.title: Skincare Content | A Human Focus, a Clear Product
en.summary: Talent preparation and product imagery brought personal expression and product recognition into the same frame, providing a clear visual starting point for skincare communication.
en.preview: The person draws attention; the product information identifies the subject. Makeup preparation and production addressed both within a focused skincare assignment.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to skincare content production and makeup design, preparing the talent in relation to the product imagery.
en.context: This was a talent-led skincare content project. The image brings together a person, product and identifying graphics, requiring personal expression and a recognisable product subject to share the composition.

narrativeSections.heading: Two kinds of information
narrativeSections.text: The person offers an expressive point of entry, while the product and graphics identify the subject. Their presence in one frame gives the skincare theme a clear visual reference.

narrativeSections.heading: Preparation in service of the subject
narrativeSections.text: Makeup design formed part of the production scope, making talent preparation relevant to the skincare presentation. Content production brought the person and product together as parts of one image.

narrativeSections.heading: A basis for product communication
narrativeSections.text: The imagery offers material for product-led introductions and content editing. Its usefulness rests in a clear person-and-product relationship, with the visual presentation carrying the story.

deliverables: Makeup design for the skincare content
Visual content featuring talent, product and identifying graphics
outcomes: The resulting skincare content combines personal presentation with product recognition.
The delivery provides material for product-led editing and visual communication.
